name: Koenchu! Yonogi Seiyuu Monogatari ~Sora to Kimi to Ano Natsu to~
original_name: こえんちゅ！代乃木声優物語 ～空と君とあの夏と～
source:
Souta is a voice acting student at a technical school in Japan. He aspires to be a great voice actor one day, but it's turning out to be a lot more complicated than he planned. Girls, festivals, plays - aliens?? Lead Souta to his destiny! 

[from [url=http://www.zerozigen.us/product.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
飒太就读于日本一所专门学校的声优专业。他梦想有朝一日成为优秀声优，却发现实现梦想远比想象中复杂。少女、祭典、舞台剧——还有外星人？？引导飒太走向属于他的命运吧！

[摘自[url=http://www.zerozigen.us/product.html]官方网站[/url]]
